en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing several riders on horseback entering shallow coastal water from a stony beach. The riders wear light shirts and dark trousers, and the scene is composed with the sea and cloudy sky in the background. Printed Swedish text appears along the top margin describing a historical exhibition of the Crown Prince's Hussar Regiment and the activity of swimming with horses.
